title: Patch Plan
description: EXECUTE-stage artifact. Output of patch-planner. Describes a set of scoped file-level changes to implement (or fix) a code feature, bug, or experiment variant. A draft plan — each change is scoped to a file/path. Real implementation follows in implementation_record.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this plan. Fresh output of patch-planner is always 'draft'.

title.description: Short human-readable title for this patch.

rationale.description: Why this patch is needed (context for the implementer).

from_protocol_ref.description: Optional reference to the protocol_spec or experiment_matrix that prompted this patch.

changes.description: Ordered list of file-scoped changes. At least one required.

path.description: Relative file path scoping this change.

change_type.description: What kind of change is planned for this file.

description.description: Human-readable description of what changes and why.

snippet.description: Optional representative code snippet or pseudocode.

risk_note.description: Any risk or side-effect the implementer should know.

review_notes.description: Any reviewer comments (populated when status becomes approved/superseded).
